description: Curated MCP servers for VybeKiit vibe coders. Install what you use, not everything.

servers.name: context7
servers.description: Version-specific library docs — kills hallucinated APIs
servers.notes: Most impactful single MCP. Prevents Claude from writing code against outdated APIs.

servers.name: github
servers.description: PR review, issue triage, repo search, code context
servers.notes: Start in read-only mode. Scope toolsets to avoid tool bloat.

servers.name: playwright
servers.description: Browser automation, E2E verification, accessibility tree
servers.notes: Uses accessibility tree (200-400 tokens) instead of screenshots (thousands). Keep sessions tight.

servers.name: supabase
servers.description: Database schema, auth, storage, migrations, Edge Functions
servers.notes: Full Supabase management. Can run queries, generate migrations, manage infrastructure.

servers.name: figma
servers.description: Read designs, generate code from frames, use Code Connect
servers.notes: Claude gets structured design data — components, variables, layout. Can generate code from selected frames.

servers.name: sentry
servers.description: Production error triage, stack traces, Seer root-cause analysis
servers.notes: OAuth-based remote MCP. Seer (paid) provides automated root-cause analysis.

servers.name: vercel
servers.description: Deploy, manage projects, environment variables, domains
servers.notes: Full Vercel project management from Claude.

servers.name: stripe
servers.notes: Use test mode keys during development. Never expose live keys to agent.

servers.name: resend
servers.notes: Simple email sending. Good for auth flows, notifications, receipts.

servers.name: higgsfield
servers.description: AI image/video generation — Kling 3, Veo 3, Sora 2, Seedance, Wan
servers.notes: 30+ models through single endpoint. Paid creative asset generation.

servers.name: exa
servers.description: AI-native web search — semantic, content, neural
servers.notes: Better than web search for finding code examples, documentation, and technical content.

servers.name: firecrawl
servers.description: Web scraping, crawling, structured data extraction
servers.notes: Scrape competitor sites, extract data, crawl documentation.

servers.name: cloudflare
servers.description: Workers, KV, R2, D1, AI, Vectorize — full platform
servers.notes: Full Cloudflare platform management. Deploy Workers, manage storage, run AI.

servers.name: upstash
servers.description: Redis, QStash (queues), Vector DB — serverless data
servers.notes: Serverless Redis + message queues + vector search. Pairs well with Next.js/Vercel.

servers.name: tavily
servers.description: Deep web research, search with AI extraction
servers.notes: Best for deep research tasks — competitor analysis, market research, technical investigation.
